Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete transparent animated desktop companion sprite atlas. Create a production-ready original hand-drawn Inkbound character atlas for Klaus. Input image role: original selected art-direction reference; use only the named character. Style: confident charcoal hand-ink outlines, warm ivory highlights, muted persimmon orange and tiny dusty blue accents, restrained visible gouache texture. Preserve character proportions and clarity at a display width of 112px. Klaus, the TOP LEFT character in the supplied original Inkbound concept board ONLY. Small soot-charcoal soft-bodied fantasy imp with angular folded ivory-tipped ear/hood, cream heart-shaped face patch, large warm black eyes with tiny ivory glints, persimmon orange scarf with two short tails, little feet and mitten hands. NOT a robot. Match its exact silhouette, colors, expressive eyes, ink linework and gouache texture from the reference. All cells show ONLY this single same character.
Strict game-ready atlas geometry: exactly 1536 pixels wide by 2288 pixels tall, exactly 8 columns by 11 rows. Each cell is exactly 192x208. No margins between cells. All 88 cells have the same origin convention: character centered at cell x=96, standing baseline y=190; full silhouette remains within x=12..180, y=12..196 including ears/scarf/props. Character occupies about 146px high in neutral pose, consistent scale across every cell. Fully transparent background; NO checkerboard painted into image, no paper background, no ground line, no contact shadow outside character. Absolutely no labels, lettering, guides, borders, separators or grid lines.
ROW SPECIFICATION, counted from TOP, with column indexes starting at 0. Leave unused cells fully transparent:
Row 0: 6 idle frames, cols0..5: relaxed open eyes, half blink, closed blink, reopening, tiny breathing rise, relaxed smile. cols6..7 empty.
Row 1: 8 sequential run RIGHT frames, clear right-facing profile, coherent full run cycle with alternating feet, contact/down/passing/up/contact-other/down/passing/up.
Row 2: 8 sequential run LEFT frames, clear left-facing profile, same full cycle mirrored orientation but correct original anatomy.
Row 3: 4 greeting wave frames cols0..3, arm up / wave left / wave right / arm down. cols4..7 empty.
Row 4: 5 jump frames cols0..4: crouch, takeoff, airborne apex, landing squash, upright recovery. cols5..7 empty.
Row 5: 8 setback frames: stumble, tip, sit, disappointed, sigh, brace, stand up, recovered. No injury.
Row 6: 6 waiting frames cols0..5: glance aside, head tilt, ear flick, foot tap, sigh, forward. cols6..7 empty.
Row 7: 6 working frames cols0..5: conjure small ink orb, focus, manipulate, adjust, concentrated hands, satisfied progress; recognizable active work and expressive hands. cols6..7 empty.
Row 8: 6 review frames cols0..5: hold small ivory folio, scan left, scan down, inspect with little magnifier, thoughtful tilt, approving nod. cols6..7 empty.
Row 9: 8 gaze frames, all with exactly SAME front-facing neutral standing body, open eyes and small pupils look clockwise: up, up-right22.5, up-right45, up-right67.5, right, down-right112.5, down-right135, down-right157.5.
Row 10: 8 gaze frames, SAME neutral body: down, down-left202.5, down-left225, down-left247.5, left, up-left292.5, up-left315, up-left337.5.
Do not substitute 8 rows or 10 rows. Count eleven equal-height rows carefully. Do not repeat one static pose throughout action rows. Keep all character identities/features stable with no morphing. This is a sprite atlas, not a concept page or character lineup.
